title: Zero-Context Independent Physical Meteorology Audit — Continental Central Anatolia, Eastern Anatolian Siberian Inversion, Lake Van 700 hPa LES & Southeastern Mesopotamian Regimes

nonCompliantHighPlateauProvinces.note: Barrier crests (700 hPa) and Lake Van LES (700 hPa) are compliant, but inversionAndWedgeSpec.deltaPressureTopHpa=780 exceeds <=750 hPa and is subterranean across Başkale (2286 m, ~767 hPa) and ground-level in Saray/Çaldıran (2050-2117 m).

Bitlis Merkez (MGM 17208) sits at 1789 m (~816 hPa ISA, higher than Van 1675 m and Kars 1775 m), yet deltaPressureTopHpa=820 is subterranean relative to city center and coldPoolTopM (1405+340=1745 m) falls below 1789 m.

engineSubterranean850Trap.summary: Engine solvers hardcode wind850DirDeg/wind850SpeedKmh for Froude Foehn, upslope, and shallowColdWedgeRule (minWindShearVs850Deg) and ignore DirectionalBarrierRule.crestPressureHpa=700, even where 850 hPa (~1457 m ISA) is 125-440 m underground across >=1500 m Eastern Anatolia.

gaps: Numeric MGM twin 17128 (Esenboğa Airport, owned by TR-06) is missing from SPEC_TR_06.stationOverrides.
coldBasinAirportIcaos=['LTAC'] was exported on detached TR_06_BESPOKE_MODIFIERS instead of SPEC_TR_06.urbanHeatIsland, disabling province-cressman airportPenalty=0.22.
Numeric MGM twin 17194 (owned by TR-50) is missing from SPEC_TR_50.stationOverrides.

criticalBoundViolations.recordStation: MGM 18091 Sarıcakaya (220 m, 2023-08-15 official national record)

criticalBoundViolations.lowlandSubBasinStation: MGM 18150 Karkamış (375 m Euphrates border floor) & 18153 Nizip (477 m)

criticalBoundViolations.frostHollowStation: MGM 18121 Derinkuyu (1320 m closed frost hollow, reaches -31..-34°C)

falseInlandReservoirHeavyDekBug.mechanism: TR-02 (Atatürk Dam 540 m, fetch=34 km), TR-63 (Atatürk Bozova Arm 540 m, fetch=32 km), and TR-72 (Ilısu Canyon Reservoir 525 m, fetch=28 km) erroneously set convectiveInstabilityUpperHpa=700 at ~950 hPa lowland elevation with effectiveFetchKm >= 25 km, while TR-42 Konya (Beyşehir 1123 m, fetch=26 km) set dekWatchDeltaTC=28/dekHeavyDeltaTC=32 to suppress LES. In lib/snow-and-lightning-engine.ts:853-855, Math.min(wb.dekHeavyDeltaTC, 15.0) overwrites 23.5-32°C guards down to 15.0°C against 700 hPa, causing false 'heavy_dek' alerts in Şanlıurfa, Adıyaman, Batman, Konya, and Isparta during ordinary winter fronts.

defects.title: False 'heavy_dek' (Heavy Sea/Lake-Effect Snow) fires in Şanlıurfa (TR-63), Adıyaman (TR-02), Batman (TR-72), Konya (TR-42), and Isparta (TR-32)
defects.physicalMechanism: 1) Low-altitude (~525-540 m, ~950 hPa) dam reservoirs in TR-02 (ataturk_dam_reservoir, fetch=34 km), TR-63 (ataturk_reservoir_bozova_arm, fetch=32 km), and narrow canyon TR-72 (ilisu_tigris_reservoir, fetch=28 km) misconfigured convectiveInstabilityUpperHpa=700 (3010 m) and effectiveFetchKm >= 25 km. Over a 2470 m layer (540 m -> 3010 m), even a neutral winter column (T_water=+8.6°C, T700=-10°C) yields ΔT=18.6°C. 2) Worse, lib/snow-and-lightning-engine.ts:853-855 uses Math.min(wb.dekWatchDeltaTC, 10.5) and Math.min(wb.dekHeavyDeltaTC, 15.0), erasing the authors' intentional suppression thresholds (23.5-24°C on Atatürk/Ilısu; 28/32°C on Konya Beyşehir) down to 10.5/15.0°C and triggering 'heavy_dek' across hyper-arid Mesopotamian and Central Anatolian plains.
defects.remediation: 1) In lib/snow-and-lightning-engine.ts:853-855, respect wb.dekWatchDeltaTC and wb.dekHeavyDeltaTC (do not clamp downward with Math.min) and restrict true high-altitude LES to alkaline/deep lakes with fetch >= 50 km (Lake Van). 2) In TR-02, TR-63, and TR-72 specs, change convectiveInstabilityUpperHpa from 700 to 850 and reduce narrow dendritic reservoir effectiveFetchKm below 22 km (< 25 km DEK gate).

defects.title: TR-26 Eskişehir maxPlausibleTempC=42°C clips Sarıcakaya (+49.5°C historical national record) by 7.5°C
defects.physicalMechanism: Sarıcakaya (MGM 18091, 220 m) and Mihalgazi (MGM 19372, 236 m) sit in the deep Middle Sakarya canyon inside TR-26, where +49.5°C was recorded on 2023-08-15. Because solveProvinceTopographicSurface (province-cressman.ts:838,1069) and computeProvinceLiveVerticalProfile (province-vertical-profile.ts:487) filter out any station with tempC > spec.qcAndMosBounds.maxPlausibleTempC, summer heatwave readings >42.0°C in Sarıcakaya/Mihalgazi are rejected as sensor errors and output is clamped to 42.0°C.

defects.title: High-altitude (>=1500 m) Lake Van provinces TR-65 Van (deltaPressureTopHpa=780) and TR-13 Bitlis (deltaPressureTopHpa=820) violate <=750 hPa (700 hPa) inversion-top reference
defects.physicalMechanism: In TR-65 Van (center 1675 m, ~828 hPa; Çaldıran 2050 m; Saray 2117 m; Başkale 2286 m, ~767 hPa), deltaPressureTopHpa=780 exceeds <=750 hPa and lies underground at Başkale. In TR-13 Bitlis, primaryCenter (MGM 17208) is at 1789 m (~816 hPa ISA), so deltaPressureTopHpa=820 sits below surface pressure at city center and basinFloorElevationM+coldPoolMaxDepthM (1405+340=1745 m) fails to reach 1789 m.
defects.remediation: Set inversionAndWedgeSpec.deltaPressureTopHpa to 700 on both TR-65 and TR-13, and raise TR-13 coldPoolMaxDepthM to >=480 m (coldPoolTopM >=1885 m).

defects.title: Dual-unit schema bifurcation on SurfaceRelativeInversionSpec.deltaPressureTopHpa across the 80 provinces (31 relative delta-hPa vs 49 absolute isobaric-top-hPa)
defects.physicalMechanism: 31 province specs (including 8 AUD-02 specs: TR-23=36, TR-24=48, TR-42=38, TR-44=33, TR-50=34, TR-51=36, TR-62=48, TR-68=36) store pressure thickness ΔP = P_sfc - P_top in [18, 48] hPa, whereas 49 specs (including 27 AUD-02 specs) store absolute top pressure P_top in [700, 990] hPa.
defects.remediation: Standardize all 80 specs onto explicit upper-reference pressure topPressureHpa (700/750/800/850/925 hPa) or add a unit-safe resolver (val < 200 ? P_sfc - val : val) before wiring into upper-air profile blending.

defects.title: Engine Froude Foehn, upslope, and shallowColdWedgeRule solvers hardcode subterranean 850 hPa winds instead of respecting crestPressureHpa=700
defects.physicalMechanism: Over >=1500 m Eastern Anatolian basins (1582-1895 m centers, ~805-837 hPa), the 850 hPa isobaric surface (~1457 m ISA) is 125-440 m underground. Yet ProvinceAmbientDrivers only accepts wind850DirDeg/wind850SpeedKmh, shallowColdWedgeRule is typed as minWindShearVs850Deg, and applyDirectionalBarrierRules ignores rule.crestPressureHpa (700 hPa).
defects.remediation: Add wind700DirDeg/wind700SpeedKmh to ProvinceAmbientDrivers and ComputeProvinceVerticalProfileParams, route barriers with crestPressureHpa <= 750 and high-elevation cold-wedge shear checks to 700 hPa flow.

defects.title: excludeFromCenterHeadline is unread by runtime solvers and coldBasinAirportIcaos is detached or missing in multiple specs
defects.physicalMechanism: 1) ProvinceStationOverride.excludeFromCenterHeadline is never read in province-cressman.ts or mgm-national-live.ts. 2) TR-06 (LTAC) and TR-26 (LTBY, LTBI) placed coldBasinAirportIcaos inside detached TR_XX_BESPOKE_MODIFIERS constants rather than spec.urbanHeatIsland (alongside TR-03, TR-15, TR-20, TR-32, TR-40, TR-43, TR-71), leaving spec.urbanHeatIsland undefined so airportPenalty=0.22 never triggers.
defects.remediation: Enforce override.excludeFromCenterHeadline attenuation/filtering when solving center headlines in province-cressman.ts, and attach urbanHeatIsland.coldBasinAirportIcaos directly onto SPEC_TR_06, SPEC_TR_26, SPEC_TR_27, SPEC_TR_30, SPEC_TR_47, SPEC_TR_50.

defects.title: Asymmetric or missing numeric MGM twin overrides for cold-basin airports and TR-27 catalog Oğuzeli center drift
defects.physicalMechanism: Live MGM sondurum observations arrive keyed by numeric istNo rather than ICAO: TR-06 omits 17128 (Esenboğa), TR-50 omits 17194 (Kapadokya), TR-26 omits 17123 and leaves 17124 unexcluded while excluding LTBI/LTBY, TR-27 leaves 17260 unexcluded in the same sub-basin (coupling=1.0) while excluding LTAJ (and catalog-1102.ts:64 / mgm-national-live.ts:91 still place Gaziantep center at 700 m Oğuzeli Airport), and rural frost-bowl airports LTCU (TR-12), LTCK/17206 (TR-49), LTAU/17195 (TR-38), LTAN/17244 (TR-42), LTCC/17280 (TR-21), LTCJ/17284 (TR-72) lack excludeFromCenterHeadline.
defects.remediation: Add symmetric numeric MGM overrides (17128, 17194, 17123, 17206), set excludeFromCenterHeadline=true on 17260/17124 and rural frost-basin airports, isolate Oğuzeli into its own sub-basin, and align catalog-1102 TR-27 center to 854 m Şahinbey.

defects.title: Tight sub-basin temperature and Siberian-High reduced MSLP QC bounds risk rejecting valid extremes at Karkamış, Derinkuyu, Mount Ararat, Uzunyayla, and >=1000 m basins
defects.physicalMechanism: 1) TR-27 maxPlausibleTempC=45°C is exceeded in 375 m Karkamış/Nizip (46-47.5°C). 2) TR-50 minPlausibleTempC=-29°C clips Derinkuyu (18121, -31..-34°C); TR-76 (-32°C vs 5137 m Ararat), TR-38 (-34°C vs Uzunyayla/Erciyes -37°C), TR-51 (-30°C vs Aladağlar), TR-73 (-28°C vs Kato/Beytüşşebap) are tight for high alpine/frost-hollow AWS stations. 3) High plateaus TR-50/51 (1046 hPa), TR-40/42 (1048 hPa), TR-24/66/73 (1050 hPa) drop valid cold-core Siberian High reduced MSLPs (1052-1058 hPa).
defects.remediation: Widen TR-27 maxPlausibleTempC to 48°C, TR-50 minPlausibleTempC to -35°C, TR-38/76/51/73 alpine minPlausibleTempC to <= -36..-40°C, and >=1000 m continental maxPlausibleMslpHpa to >=1056 hPa.

defects.title: Minor metadata drift: role='coast'/'marine_upwind' on landlocked provinces, TR-73 basinFloorElevationM=1450 above 400 m Cizre, and unadjusted CLIM elevation offset on TR-13/TR-25
defects.physicalMechanism: Landlocked provinces TR-30, TR-50, TR-51, TR-56, TR-68, TR-73 use role='coast' on low river plains and TR-79 uses role='marine_upwind' despite waterBodies=[]. TR-73 sets basinFloorElevationM=1450 above Cizre (400 m) and Şırnak Merkez (1350 m). TR-13 (+216 m vs 1573 m CLIM) and TR-25 (+137 m Yakutiye vs 1758 m LTCE CLIM) assign unadjusted monthly normals.
defects.remediation: Replace role='coast'/'marine_upwind' with 'plain'/'corridor' on waterBodies=[] specs, anchor TR-73 basinFloorElevationM accurately or document highland-only cold pool, and apply lapse/foothill normal offsets to TR-13 and TR-25.
